integrity: The proof reduces the one-coordinate problem to an exact two-dimensional diamond lemma, then optimizes one scalar outer-mass parameter. The global lower bound uses arbitrarily small outer coordinates in an infinite ell_p sequence. A bundled exact-rational checker is supplementary. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The pointwise profile is proved only for one-coordinate points in the infinite outer ell_p sum with fibre ell_1^2. The global index is exact on the whole unit sphere, but arbitrary-point profiles and higher-dimensional ell_1 fibres are not classified.
title: Exact local-octahedrality profile of diamond-valued \(\ell_p\) sequence spaces
